spans.text: ...SOP-II successfully enters the Griffin resupply point.
Hehe, looks like my plan worked really well.
Helloooo, anyone there?
...Anybody?
In the end...I'm still alone, huh...
Where...did everyone go...?
...SOP-II inspects her surroundings.
This place is a mess, but there are no signs of a fight. Could it have been an emergency withdrawal?
Still, the footprints are fresh, so they couldn't have gone too far. If I chase them now I might make it in time...
But I don't know where they ran to either. I should look in the warehouse just in case.
...SOP-II runs up to the warehouse.
I wonder if my current body could get past the authentication?
(Pushes) ...Eh?
Hey! The door's not even closed!
...SOP-II pokes her head inside and looks around.
Ah...it's empty after all.
They didn't leave anything behind. Now we've both been abandoned, RO, haha...
...SOP-II looks down in dejection and stares at the ground.
...Then, she notices the footprints in the mud.
These footprints... No...
Griffin doesn't have anything with four legs!
...Ah! Dinergates! Dinergates must have taken away all the stuff in here!
Which means...
...SOP-II starts organizing her thoughts.
S.F. must have looted this resupply point, but the Griffin forces must have run off ahead of time.
In that case, the most likely possibility is that...
All that stuff was taken to a nearby Sangvis resupply point, right?
Awww...
...SOP-II brings up her electronic map.
This sort of thing is too risky, even for me.
Dear RO635...the things I do for friendship.
